name: Mechanism facts
notes: Facts written by signal graph fact receivers (src/content/data/signal-graph), so quests, dialogue and level variants can read what a mechanism did. A fact receiver's key must be declared here.

facts.description: The Chapel of Echoes portcullis has dropped (its rope cut or burnt: signal graph chapel-portcullis). One way to trap Brother Horn (story bible §4.2, Trick).
The Kestrel Lock gate is open (both paddles up: signal graph kestrel-lock-gates).
